title: Commercial & Industrial Rooftop
summary: Power-dense solar modules and standard system packages for factories, warehouses, packaging plants, dealerships and high-load commercial buildings.

painPoints.title: High daytime electricity demand
painPoints.description: Factories, warehouses and retail buildings need solar packages that match large roof areas and daytime load curves.

painPoints.title: Fast proposal turnaround
painPoints.description: EPC teams need module specs, case proof and BOM direction before they can submit a credible commercial proposal.

painPoints.title: Document-heavy procurement
painPoints.description: Commercial buyers often require datasheets, certificates, warranty policy and logistics details before shortlisting suppliers.

solutionApproach: Use high-power N-type modules with grid-tied or solar-plus-storage packages to create a repeatable rooftop offer for commercial buildings. Connect the application page to product specs, case references and RFQ forms so buyers can move from scenario research to quote requests quickly.
buyerChecklist: Roof area and usable mounting zone
Target system capacity and load profile

faqs.question: Which modules fit commercial rooftop projects?
faqs.answer: High-power 580W and 620W modules are typically positioned for commercial rooftop projects where roof utilization and system output matter.

faqs.question: Can storage be included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Storage can be discussed as part of a solar-plus-storage package when the buyer needs backup power, load shifting or higher self-consumption.

ctaTitle: Need a commercial rooftop solar package?
ctaDescription: Send roof size, target capacity, market and project timeline. Callsun can respond with module options, package direction and document links.
